name: io.github.0xsl1m/cerebrus-pulse-mcp
title: Cerebrus Pulse MCP
description: Real-time Hyperliquid perps intelligence: TA, funding, OI, liquidations. Pay-per-call via x402.

environmentVariables.name: CEREBRUS_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated, low-balance Base wallet for x402 auto-payment. Leave unset to use free tools and get payment terms only.

environmentVariables.name: CEREBRUS_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Largest single payment auto-pay may sign, in USD.

environmentVariables.name: CEREBRUS_MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Total auto-pay may sign while the server process runs, in USD.

environmentVariables.name: CEREBRUS_ALLOWED_PAYTO
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated payTo addresses auto-pay may pay. Defaults to the published Cerebrus Pulse Base address.
